data.lead: Picking the wrong agent can cost homeowners tens of thousands — in commission, marketing, and a price that falls short. Agent Finder gives you a calm, guided way to compare your options before you commit.

items.title: Compare trusted local agents
items.body: We shortlist agents who actually work — and recently sold — in your suburb, not just anyone willing to pay for leads.

items.title: Understand fees & marketing
items.body: See realistic commission and marketing costs side‑by‑side, with plain‑English notes on what’s reasonable for your area.

items.title: Get independent support
items.body: A real property advisor stays beside you — from the first conversation to signing the agreement. No agent pressure.

data.heading: Ready to find
